coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/1; translational subset). Enrols recurrent GBM (WHO 2021) and brain metastases from any primary, so coded basket_gbm_eligible / basket true (could alternatively be viewed as a GBM trial with a brain-metastasis cohort). Expansion is restricted to patients with a positive tumour PK response, which is a pharmacokinetic, not molecular, selection criterion, so not coded as a biomarker. B7-H3 is measured as a pharmacodynamic marker, not required for entry. pH2AX coded candidate-matched as a DNA-damage readout of the ADC payload (payload mechanism not stated in record).
